graphEvents.label: Closed kind tuple and three tables
Frozen adapter map and five-step adapter

label: EXECUTOR_KINDS is a closed eight-entry tuple, and adding a kind means editing the tuple, EXECUTOR_KIND_FLAG_SUPPORT and EXECUTOR_PREVENTIVE_SANDBOX_CAPABILITY together.

Flag support is per-kind and enforced by an unsupported-field scan; cli-mistral-vibe should declare model, timeoutSeconds and liveTools and must not declare reasoningEffort because Vibe has no such flag.
A closed model roster is a module-level constant plus a predicate plus a default, as PI_SUPPORTED_MODELS and isPiSupportedModel show; cli-mistral-vibe needs the same trio.

The command builder is a frozen LINEAGE_COMMAND_ADAPTERS map that throws on an unknown kind, and every adapter follows preflight, roster check, provider mapping, argument assembly, then finalizeLineageCommand.
finalizeLineageCommand builds effectiveConfig and an invocationFingerprint and fails closed when a kind cannot honor a sandbox mode, as cli-opencode does for anything but danger-full-access.

The env allowlist has a common set, per-kind exact keys and per-kind prefixes; cli-mistral-vibe needs the VIBE_ prefix plus MISTRAL_API_KEY as an explicit key because that name carries no VIBE_ prefix.

runAuditedExecutorCommand validates against the recursion guard, writes INTENT and COMPLETION receipts and spawns with the filtered env; the guard matches executable basenames through an ancestor walk, so both vibe and vibe-rs must be recognised.

Each kind needs a stress file under tests/stress/cli-adapter plus live-contracts and matrix-manifest entries, and executor-branch-contract.vitest.ts fails the build when a non-native kind has no if_cli_ branch in all four deep-loop YAMLs.
The inline research YAML carries branches only for native, cli-claude-code, cli-opencode and cli-codex, so cli-mistral-vibe needs either a new inline branch or the documented fan-out-only path.

reason: Vibe has no reasoning-effort CLI flag and the unsupported-field scan would reject the field.
